title: ReactiveOrderEvent
description: One order check for Reactive Writing: a human load-bearing draft before any suggestion (先承重再建议). Process evidence only: hashes, never corpus text. Not an author verdict, not a 知音 result, and not a close of E05b or E7. gate_result is block when load_bearing_present is false and allow when it is true. phase must match that pair plus suggestion_attempted: await_load_bearing (false, false), suggest_blocked (false, true), load_bearing_ready (true, false), suggest_allowed (true, true). reason_code is missing_load_bearing on block and ok_after_human_draft on allow.

event_id.description: Stable id for this order check.

ts_iso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the order check.

phase.description: Where the session is in the order. Suggestions are not a phase that can precede the human draft.

load_bearing_present.description: Whether a human load-bearing draft is already present. Not a model score. false keeps the gate shut.

suggestion_attempted.description: Whether a suggestion was attempted at this check. An attempt with no load-bearing draft is recorded as blocked, not dropped.

gate_result.description: Must be block when load_bearing_present is false, and allow when it is true.

reason_code.description: missing_load_bearing pairs with block. ok_after_human_draft pairs with allow. A reason code is not an author verdict.

span.description: Optional sha256 of the before/after spans, or empty strings. Hashes only. Do not put raw text or offsets here.

notes.description: Optional short note. Do not paste corpus text. A note is not an author verdict and does not close an arm.
